question: Provide the complete information for students with the first name Kevin, including their full names, email addresses, department names, department phone numbers, school names, and the total student count per department and school. If a student is associated with more than one department, list a separate row for each department.

WITH kevin_students AS (
  SELECT
    msd.FULL_NAME,
    msd.EMAIL_ADDRESS,
    msd.DEPARTMENT,
    sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME,
    sad.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER,
    sd.SCHOOL_NAME
  FROM MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY msd
  LEFT JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON msd.DEPARTMENT = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE
  LEFT JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT sad ON msd.DEPARTMENT = sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE
  WHERE msd.FIRST_NAME = 'Kevin'
),
department_school_counts AS (
  SELECT
    msd.DEPARTMENT,
    sd.SCHOOL_NAME,
    COUNT(DISTINCT msd.FULL_NAME) AS total_student_count
  FROM MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY msd
  LEFT JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON msd.DEPARTMENT = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE
  GROUP BY msd.DEPARTMENT, sd.SCHOOL_NAME
)

  ks.EMAIL_ADDRESS,
  ks.DEPARTMENT_NAME,
  ks.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER,
  ks.SCHOOL_NAME,
  dsc.total_student_count
FROM kevin_students ks
LEFT JOIN department_school_counts dsc
  ON ks.DEPARTMENT = dsc.DEPARTMENT
